title: Bounded canonical-graph typo tolerance

scope.subject: Add one-edit or adjacent-transposition typo fallback over bounded canonical destination title/alias tokens while preserving exact/prefix ranking and avoiding fuzzy scans of the full YEIS star catalog

research_summary: Agent 07 requires typo-tolerance evidence, but the current product already has a bounded canonical Places graph plus native YEIS domain searches. A full Fuse/MiniSearch dependency or fuzzy index over the 109k-star catalog would add cost and a second ranking layer for a small need. Reuse the existing canonical graph: after exact/prefix/corpus matching fails, compare normalized query variants only against destination title/alias tokens with a strict one-edit-or-adjacent-transposition predicate. Assign this fallback a score below ordinary corpus matches, so exact IDs/titles/aliases and prefixes remain authoritative. Long-tail catalog search remains native/exact and is not fuzzy-scanned.

sources.finding: Fuse.js is a mature fuzzy-search solution, but introducing another dependency/index for the current bounded canonical graph is disproportionate and risks a parallel ranking surface.
Fuse confirms that generic fuzzy ranking supports broader patterns and scoring, but Personal Universe only needs a conservative typo fallback after its product-specific exact/prefix ranking.
Existing hosted Playwright can verify misspelled destination discovery through the real Search surface without a separate search-test harness.

search_ladder.conclusion: Retain the current YEIS-backed canonical destination/search product and add typo fallback only to already-resolved product destinations.
Fuse/cmdk are mature generic fuzzy options but are larger than needed for a bounded one-edit fallback and would create another scoring/index surface.
Keep native YEIS search for long-tail astronomy; typo fallback must not scan or replace the full catalog search subsystem.
Reuse existing browser acceptance to prove conservative typo recovery and ranking order.

coverage_matrix.capability: One ordinary insertion/deletion/substitution or adjacent transposition can recover a canonical title/alias
coverage_matrix.decision: Match only normalized title/alias tokens of already-resolved canonical destinations after normal matching fails.

coverage_matrix.capability: Exact ID/title/alias/prefix results always outrank typo fallback
coverage_matrix.decision: Assign typo fallback below ordinary corpus-match score and retain current exact/prefix/product priors.

coverage_matrix.capability: No fuzzy scan/index rebuild touches the full YEIS star catalog per keystroke
coverage_matrix.decision: Keep typo helper inside canonical graph matching only; native catalog/domain searches remain unchanged.

decision.rationale: Implement the smallest conservative typo glue over canonical title/alias tokens and verify it in the existing browser suite. Do not add Fuse/index state until actual catalog growth or typo requirements exceed one-edit recovery.

higher_level_tradeoffs.reason: More capable fuzzy ranking would duplicate the product scorer and add bundle/index complexity for no current evidence of need.

decision.fallback: If future product evidence requires multi-edit/fuzzy phrase ranking, wrap Fuse/MiniSearch around canonical IDs only; never let it mint identities or replace native YEIS catalog search.
